title: dev.qory.run.exited
description: The run ended: the runtime exited, or the run was ended without one. The result of the run and its last event. Every run.exited contains state, how the run ended: succeeded, failed or cancelled. A session's run contains exit_code too, the runtime's exit status, -1 with gateway_lost and in every dev.qory.run.exited the gateway writes for it; a run a gateway opened has no process and contains no exit_code, gateway_lost included. The schema cannot tell the two apart, since this event does not contain opened_by: dev.qory.run.started does. It fixes state to failed with gateway_lost, and exit_code to -1 when it is present, and does not require exit_code. The gateway's dev.qory.run.exited of a session's run that it ends has exit_code -1, and the state of its ending, the README's §The events, How a run ends; the session's own record of the code of the gateway's 410 has the runtime's exit status, so the schema fixes neither for those reasons.

state.description: How the run ended, on every run.exited, of a session's run and of a run a gateway opened alike. succeeded: the run ended well; failed: it ended badly; cancelled: it was stopped before it said how it went. A session's runtime that exits by itself is succeeded on exit status 0 and failed otherwise, a signal included, unless its starter gave an outcome. A run its starter ended with an outcome, qory_outcome in the answer of its introspection endpoint, has that outcome (the README's §Run credentials). Forager's own endings: cancelled with timeout, interrupted, quiet, credential_expired and stopped; failed with session_lost, gateway_lost, batch_refused, credential_check_unreachable and credential_check_invalid.

exit_code.description: The runtime's exit status, or -1 when it was killed by a signal, and -1 when the gateway ends a session's run, which holds no exit status of the runtime's. Present on a session's run, absent on a run a gateway opened.

signal.description: The signal that killed the runtime, when one did: SIGKILL, SIGTERM.

reason.description: Why the run ended, when it ended other than by the runtime's own exit, or the reason its starter gave: an open code, a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and _, up to 64 characters. Forager's own codes are reserved: timeout, interrupted, quiet, credential_expired, stopped, session_lost, gateway_lost, batch_refused, credential_check_unreachable, credential_check_invalid and run_closed; and so are the old names run_ended_at_issuer, issuer_unreachable and issuer_answer_invalid, which Forager never writes. Any other code is the starter's, qory_reason in the answer of its introspection endpoint, carried as given; a starter's reason that equals a reserved code, or that is not a code, is dropped, and the run has no reason, its outcome kept (the README's §Run credentials). timeout: the run's time limit was reached and the session stopped the runtime. interrupted: the session's run was stopped from where it was started, a Ctrl-C or a signal to the program that runs the session, before the session observed the runtime's exit; exit_code and signal are the runtime's. quiet: a run with no session had no connection for the gateway's quiet period, quiet_seconds. credential_expired: the run credential's exp passed with no fresh credential for the same run key. stopped: the run's starter answered that the run credential is no longer active and gave no outcome, or ended so another run of the same run key, which the gateway then holds. session_lost: the gateway heard nothing from the session for 3 × its heartbeat interval. gateway_lost: the gateway was lost before the runtime's exit was recorded, because Forager died, and the event is written after the run has ended, by whatever sends the record again; duration_ms runs to the last event recorded. batch_refused: the gateway refused a batch of the session's (§The gateway's link); the gateway writes it in its record, and the session in its own. credential_check_unreachable: the run credential could not be checked, since the introspection endpoint could not be reached after the gateway's tries; the gateway holds nothing. credential_check_invalid: the run credential could not be checked, since the introspection endpoint gave no valid answer; the gateway holds nothing. The session writes timeout and interrupted, and posts them; in its own record alone it records the reason of the gateway's 410, and run_closed, the gateway's 410 to a run already ended there, after the session's final event or when the gateway stops, which no other record holds. The resend of a record writes gateway_lost, and the gateway the others. A session's batch on the link carries no reason of Forager's but timeout and interrupted, or the starter's reason from the gateway's outcome answer. Absent when the runtime ended by itself and no reason was given, when it was stopped from outside Forager, and when the starter gave an outcome with no reason or with a reserved one.

quiet_seconds.description: The quiet period the gateway applied, in seconds. Present when reason is quiet, absent otherwise.

duration_ms.description: Milliseconds from run.started to the run's end.
